2026-08.headline: Nearly Half of August Condo Sales on Oʻahu Closed Below $500,000 More than 1,200 listings remained available at that price point as the single-family median rose 12.2% on stronger sales above $1.3 million

evidence_sentences.dom_sf: Single-family homes continued to move quickly in August, spending a median of 17 days on the market compared to 22
evidence_sentences.dom_condo: Condo median days on market also improved year-over-year, declining from 48 to 37 days
evidence_sentences.active_inventory: Active inventory held relatively steady for single-family homes, up 0.5% year-over-year to 794 listings, while condo active inventory rose 4.1% to 2,512 listings
evidence_sentences.new_listings: New listings increased in both markets compared to last August, rising 14.5% year-over-year to 364 single-family homes and 6.4% to 684 condos
evidence_sentences.pending: Single-family home pending sales declined 7.6% year-over-year to 279. Condo pending sales fell 3.2% to 393
evidence_sentences.pct_olp: Sellers received a median of 100% of their original asking price for single-family homes, up from 98.8% a year ago. Fifty-one percent of single-family home sales closed at or above asking, with 33% closing above asking. Condo sellers received a median of 97.1% of their original asking price, compared to 96.4%
evidence_sentences.ytd_sales: Year-to-date, single-family home sales were up 5.9% compared to the same period last year, while condo sales were down 1.6%
evidence_sentences.le_500k: buyers closed on 183 properties priced at $500,000 and below in August, bringing the year-to-date total to 1,397 sales. At month’s end, 1,232 active listings remained available in that range

2026-07.headline: O‘ahu Single-Family Home Sales Jump 20.5% in July as Median Price Rises Sales above $1.3 million nearly doubled year-over-year, while one in three homes sold still closed under $1 million

evidence_sentences.dom_sf: Single-family homes spent a median of just 14 days on the market, down from 20
evidence_sentences.dom_condo: condos spent a median of 38 days on the market, down from 50
evidence_sentences.active_inventory_jul: single-family active listings were down 5.9% year-over-year to 802, while condo active inventory rose 3.9% to 2,554
evidence_sentences.new_listings_jul: single-family new listings up 3.0% year-over-year to 380, and condo new listings up 9.3% to 707
evidence_sentences.pending_jul: Pending sales softened in both markets, down 2.1% for single-family homes and 16.3% for condos
evidence_sentences.pct_olp_jul: Single-family home sellers received a median of 100% of their original asking price in July, up from 99.4% a year ago, and 33% of sales closed above the original asking price, up from 26% in July 2025. Condo sellers received a median of 96.6% of their original asking price, compared to 96.3%
evidence_sentences.ytd_sales: Year-to-date, single-family home sales volume was up 6.5% year-over-year, while the condo market trailed 0.8%

evidence_sentences.dom_sf: Single-family homes recorded a median of 26 days on market, up from 19
evidence_sentences.dom_condo: condo median was 40 days compared to 31
evidence_sentences.new_listings_sep25: single-family home listings down 6.0% year-over-year to 330. Condo listings saw a 1.1% bump to 638

All Properties Combined includes property types beyond SF+condo.

notes: HBR September 2026 Oahu release was not published as of 2026-10-08 ~06:00 UTC (hicentral mpr-2026-09.php 404; Prezly feed newest = Aug release of 2026-09-06). Prior releases were posted on the 6th of the following month, so this one is late; re-pull https://www.hicentral.com/mpr/mpr-2026-09.php.
HBR figures are MLS resales (single-family and condo) for Oahu; median DOM is median days on market; "% of original list price received" is a median.

Months of remaining inventory: no official HBR figure is public. oahu.months_of_inventory_2026_08.derived is our own ratio (formula given) and must be labelled as derived. ShowingTime convention (used by RAM) divides inventory by trailing-12-month average PENDING sales, which we cannot reproduce for Oahu (no 12-month pending series).

Title Guaranty Residential Sales Reports (RSR) are the only September 2026 source for Oahu, Kauai and Hawaii Island. For Maui and Kauai they reproduce board figures exactly; for Oahu they use a broader MLS universe than HBR resales (see oahu.title_guaranty_rsr.caveat); for Hawaii Island they differ slightly from board/DBEDT figures. RSR month-over-month changes use revised prior-month counts (e.g. Oahu Aug SF 274 in the Aug report vs 278 in the Sep report chart).

TG RSR arrow glyphs in the PDF text layer were decoded as m=up, q=down (verified against the rendered Oahu Sep 2026 page and against 309 vs 278 = +11.2%). Sidebar values printed as $1.4 M etc. are rounded in the source.
Neighbor-island monthly medians are volatile (Kauai Sep 2026: 18 SF and 6 condo sales; Hawaii Island condo ~30/month).
RAM narrative page (ShowingTime boilerplate) mentions national context (Fed raised rates Sep 16 2026; 30-yr above 7% late Sep). Not used as data; Freddie Mac PMMS taken directly.

DBEDT MEI August 2026 housing rows are compiled from the boards/HIS/TG; small differences vs TG Statewide exist for Hawaii County (153 vs 154 SF sales; condo median $493,000 vs $446,450) and Kauai Aug 2025 condo (26/$680,000 vs 24/$782,000) - likely revision timing. See cross_source_checks.
DBEDT state general fund revenue for Aug 2026 is (NA) in MEI; GET and TAT are available.

Freddie Mac PMMS: latest available week 2026-10-01 (30-yr 7.28%, 15-yr 6.60%); the 2026-10-08 survey is released at 12:00 ET and was not out at retrieval. Monthly averages are simple means of weekly values (our computation).

Kauai Board of REALTORS and Hawaii Island REALTORS/Hawaii Information Service sites could not be fetched (connect failure / captcha). No owner names or addresses are involved in this dataset; regional neighbourhood tables in TG RSR were not extracted.
